newsitem.title: USA: Grafix says Shamrock to invest $6.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Grafix says Shamrock to invest $6.5 mln.

text.p: Grafix Time Corp said on Wednesday Shamrock Investment Group Inc had agreed to invest $6.5 million in Grafix through a private equity placement.

The golf products company said in a statement it would use the funds to buy inventory to fill orders from Japan's Citizen Trading Group and develop new products, as well as for direct marketing expenses and working capital.
The deal is subject to approval by Grafix shareholders and the Shamrock board of directors, Grafix said.

"The funding from Shamrock will allow us to continue to meet our revenue targets as we introduce our golf clubs, accessories and apparel in Japan," Grafix Chief Executive Officer Walter Sims said in a statement.
"It will also enable us to begin our U.S. marketing plan," he said. "Finally, the funding from Shamrock will allow us to apply for Nasdaq SmallCap listing immediately."
